purpose: Pre-registration. It carries the inputs a later run is scored against and no result of any kind.
subject_sha256_rule: SHA-256 over the bytes of the subject module named by PYCC_BENCH_SUBJECT. Only the digest is ever committed or published: the reference codebase is proprietary (D-244 rule 6), so neither its source nor a path naming it appears anywhere in this repository. Null means not yet registered, which the runner and scripts/check_roadmap_evidence.rb both refuse; the stage commit that registers it is the first action of the run that publishes numbers.
float_tolerance_rationale: Relative to the baseline's own magnitude, with an absolute floor of one. The arms are not bit-comparable in principle: -O2 on the Cython arm and LLVM on the --release pycc arm may both contract a*b - c*d to an FMA where the interpreter does not, so a few ulps of divergence is expected and anything larger is a defect.

machine.power_profile: AC power, pmset powermode 0 (automatic), Low Power Mode off

machine_os_amendment: Amendment (2026-09-21): `machine.os` was re-registered from `macOS 26.5.1 (build 25F80)` to `macOS 27.0 (build 26A428)`. It is the same physical machine, updated in place: `model_identifier`, `cpu`, `cores` and `memory_bytes` are unchanged and still match what the host reports. The amendment was made while the compile-unchanged census measured zero scorable subjects (issue #1039, re-measured at 0638dc9c), so no arm had been built and no result of any kind existed that could have influenced it. Amending the pin once a subject exists would be the "machine chosen after a result was seen" shape docs/TESTING.md's "Arms" bullet declares inadmissible, which is why this was settled before rather than after.
compile_unchanged_subtrees_rationale: The denominator counts the reference codebase's own library source. Walking the whole checkout instead would add its test suite and the third-party checkouts it vendors, neither of which is a reference function, and would make the compile-unchanged fraction a statement about somebody else's code.
compile_unchanged_set_digest_rule: SHA-256 over the fully-qualified function names, sorted byte-wise ascending, joined by a single \n, UTF-8, no trailing newline
compile_unchanged_set_enumerator: scripts/enumerate_annotated_functions.py, whose module docstring states the enumeration predicate in full
